art_direction: 奶油底玉绿双眼，左高右眯，懒懒向右下看。
composition_variation: Reverse the reference's dominant side: put the larger viewer-left eye slightly higher and the right eye lower and almost half its opening height. The upper lids are thick shallow arches, resting heavily over large pupils. Aim both pupils slightly down and toward viewer-right, as if giving a casual downward assessment. Let the left colored opening be a deep curved bowl while the right is a thin natural crescent beneath its lid. Keep the expression sophisticated and detached, with no inward angry lid angle.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
